```{python}
import numpy as np
import pymc as pm
import arviz as az
import pandas as pd
```

```{python}
np.random.seed(42)
n = 100
true_mu = np.array([0.0, 0.0])
true_cov = np.array([[1.0, 0.8], [0.8, 1.0]])
data_complete = np.random.multivariate_normal(true_mu, true_cov, n)
data = data_complete.copy()

missing_mask = np.random.random((n, 2)) < 0.2
data[missing_mask] = np.nan

df = pd.DataFrame(data, columns=["x1", "x2"])
obs_data = df.values.astype(np.float32)

with pm.Model() as model:
    mu = pm.Normal("mu", 0, 10, shape=2)
    sigma = pm.HalfNormal("sigma", 5, shape=2)
    full_data = pm.Normal("full_data", mu=mu, sigma=sigma, observed=obs_data)

    trace = pm.sample(
        2000,
        tune=2000,
        chains=4,
        cores=4,
        target_accept=0.99,
    )

print(az.summary(trace))
```
